source.title: ChatGPT now knows what you do on other websites via ad collector
source.author: lmbbuchodi

title.zh: ChatGPT跨站追踪机制引发隐私疑问
title.en: ChatGPT Cross-Site Tracking Raises Privacy Questions

excerpt.zh: ChatGPT跨站追踪调查称，OpenAI广告收集器可能把用户在广告主网站的浏览行为关联到ChatGPT身份，但范围与实际关联仍未完全证实。
excerpt.en: A ChatGPT cross-site tracking investigation says OpenAI may link browsing on advertiser sites to ChatGPT identities, though the full server-side join remains unverified.

text.en: How ChatGPT cross-site tracking may work

text.zh: ChatGPT跨站追踪的争议，源于一项针对OpenAI广告收集器的技术调查。调查称，ChatGPT会生成与账户或匿名设备主体相关的__obi标识，并将其存为openai.com范围内、可跨站发送的一年期Cookie。安装OpenAI广告或转化代码的第三方网站，可能在加载脚本或发送事件时把该标识带回OpenAI。
text.en: ChatGPT cross-site tracking became controversial after a technical investigation of OpenAI's ad collector. The report says ChatGPT generates an __obi identifier associated with an account or an anonymous device subject, then stores it as a one-year cookie scoped to openai.com and configured for cross-site delivery. Third-party sites carrying OpenAI advertising or conversion code may send that identifier back when loading the script or reporting events.

text.zh: 根据调查者对移动Chrome流量的观察，收集器还可能接收页面路径、转化信息，以及从表单、页面文字和标签管理器中提取的部分身份数据。姓名、邮箱和电话在传输前会进行SHA-256哈希，但国家、城市和邮政编码等地理信息可明文发送。调查记录的页面路径涉及购物、课程、活动，也包括医疗、债务和诉讼相关场景。
text.en: Based on the investigator's observations of Chrome on Android, the collector may also receive page paths, conversion data, and identity details extracted from forms, page text, and tag-manager data. Names, email addresses, and phone numbers were hashed with SHA-256 before transmission, while geography such as country, city, and postal code could be sent in clear text. Observed paths covered shopping, courses, and events, but also medical, debt, and litigation-related contexts.

text.zh: 关键影响：广告技术进入对话产品
text.en: Why this matters for an AI product

text.zh: 这套机制本身使用了广告技术中常见的跨站标识与转化像素，但放在聊天产品上会改变隐私风险的直觉边界。用户可能向AI透露不会发布在社交平台上的信息，因此把对话账户与外部浏览或购买意图连接起来，即使广告主看不到__obi，也会引发更高的透明度和同意要求。
text.en: The mechanism uses familiar adtech patterns such as cross-site identifiers and conversion pixels, but applying them to a chat product changes the privacy stakes. People may tell an AI things they would not post on social networks. Linking a conversational account with external browsing or purchase intent therefore raises stronger questions about transparency and consent, even though advertisers cannot read the __obi value themselves.

text.zh: 证据边界与仍待回答的问题

调查并未观察到OpenAI服务器最终把每个事件解析回具体ChatGPT账户；202响应只证明收集器接受了带标识的事件。观察主要来自Android版Chrome，桌面Chrome尚未测试，iOS浏览器因WebKit和第三方Cookie限制预计不适用；同步令牌也只在部分会话中出现。OpenAI支持团队表示会内部审查，但在调查发布的材料中没有回答为何将__obi归为分析Cookie，以及拒绝营销同意的用户是否仍会获得它。
text.en: The investigation did not observe OpenAI's servers finally resolving each event to a specific ChatGPT account; a 202 response only shows that the collector accepted an event carrying the identifier. The observations were mainly from Chrome on Android. Desktop Chrome was not tested, and iOS browsers are expected to block the mechanism because of WebKit and third-party-cookie limits. Sync tokens also appeared in only some sessions. OpenAI Support said the findings would be reviewed internally, but the published material did not answer why __obi is classified as an analytics cookie or whether users who refuse marketing consent still receive it.
